SELECT
    toMonth(DateKey) AS month,
    round(sum(SalesAmount - ReturnAmount - DiscountAmount - TotalCost), 2) AS online_gross_margin_dollars,
    round(
        100.0 * sum(SalesAmount - ReturnAmount - DiscountAmount - TotalCost)
        / nullIf(sum(SalesAmount - ReturnAmount - DiscountAmount), 0),
        2
    ) AS margin_percent
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
